entities.summary: The Chur–Rorschach railway line, also called the Rhine Valley line, is a standard gauge railway line in Switzerland. It belongs to the Swiss Federal Railways (SBB) and is located in the cantons of St. Gallen and the Grisons. Chur–Rorschach railway line is a railway line from Europe. Classified as Tier D (Quantitative) evidence. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
